API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivileged Portal ManagementUpdates the privileged portal for the specified ID.
Updates the privileged portal for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/praPortal/:id

Updates the privileged portal for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the privileged portal.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.
